Execute standard operational tasks and contribute to platform maintenance activities. Support the onboarding of applications and users onto secure access platforms. Work closely with application teams and internal customers to provide secure and reliable connectivity solutions. Contribute to monitoring, reporting, documentation, and operational improvements. Learn and gradually participate in automation initiatives using scripting and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Collaborate with team members, vendors, and other technical teams to solve operational challenges. Document procedures, solutions, and lessons learned. Continuously develop your technical knowledge and share insights with colleagues What we expect from You: Bachelor's degree in IT, cybersecurity, networking, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Strong interest in networking, cybersecurity, and secure access technologies. Basic understanding of networking concepts such as DNS, routing, firewalls, proxies, authentication, and access control. Eagerness to learn modern security concepts such as Zero Trust and Secure Service Edge (SSE). Analytical mindset and willingness to troubleshoot technical issues. Experience with scripting, automation, or programming is a plus. Familiarity with cloud environments is a plus.
